description: Route the 7th on-main writer (writeIssueFile / cam issue --file-local) through syncWorktreeIfOnMain so freshly-filed issues do not leave a staged-deletion in the working tree.

userStories.title: Sync the worktree after writeIssueFile CAS success
userStories.description: As a cam operator filing an issue with main checked out, I need writeIssueFile to sync the working tree to HEAD after the CAS commit so the freshly-filed issue file is committed and clean (never staged-deleted), closing the CAM-121/68 staged-deletion footgun for the 7th on-main writer.
acceptanceCriteria: src/issues/alloc.ts imports syncWorktreeIfOnMain from ../git/on-main.ts (added to the existing import block at alloc.ts:29-35, not a new import statement). [oracle: grep -q 'syncWorktreeIfOnMain' /Users/eduardo/Documents/Projects/cam-cli/src/issues/alloc.ts]

writeIssueFile calls syncWorktreeIfOnMain(cwd, [filename], spawnFn) unconditionally (no call-site branch==main gate; the helper self-detects via on-main.ts:254) inside the if (result.success) block, BEFORE the return at alloc.ts:151-152. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

A new real-git integration test in test/integration/ files an issue with main checked out (mirroring issue-file-on-main.test.ts Case B), then asserts git status --porcelain is empty (the new issue file is committed/clean, NOT staged-deleted as 'D scripts/cam/issues/CAM-NNNN.json'). [oracle: bun test test/integration]

The new integration test reverts RED if the syncWorktreeIfOnMain call is removed from writeIssueFile (it discriminates the fix, mirroring sync-worktree-on-main.test.ts's discrimination invariant). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
The full spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: FILE TO EDIT: src/issues/alloc.ts. The CAS success block is at alloc.ts:151-152 (`if (result.success) { return { id: idUnpadded, filename, sha: result.shortSha }; }`); insert the `syncWorktreeIfOnMain(cwd, [filename], spawnFn)` call before the `return`. `filename` is already in scope (alloc.ts:125). Add `syncWorktreeIfOnMain` to the EXISTING import block at alloc.ts:29-35 (which already pulls buildIndexEnv/CAS_MAX_ATTEMPTS/hashAndIndexFiles/commitAndCasAttempt/SpawnFn from ../git/on-main.ts); do not add a second import statement. NO call-site gate: syncWorktreeIfOnMain (on-main.ts:243-254) already self-detects branch and returns early when not on main, so call it unconditionally. Mirror the choke-point precedent at on-main.ts:347 (commitTreeToMain calls syncWorktreeIfOnMain(cwd, allPaths, spawnFn) right after CAS success). NEW TEST FILE: add to test/integration/. Mirror the harness in test/integration/issue-file-on-main.test.ts (makeTmpRepo seeding scripts/cam/issues/CAM-NNNN.json + project.toml, realSpawnFn forwarding env+input, afterEach tmp cleanup, test.skipIf(!gitAvailable)) and the porcelain-clean assertion pattern from test/integration/sync-worktree-on-main.test.ts (every on-main case asserts `git status --porcelain` is empty). The gap this closes: issue-file-on-main.test.ts Case B (on-main, line 208) asserts the entry lands on main but does NOT assert porcelain-clean. Test can call writeIssueFile directly OR via createLocalIssueOnMain (createLocalIssueOnMain -> writeIssueFile); calling writeIssueFile directly is the tightest unit-of-fix. GOTCHA: makeTmpRepo must run `git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main` so the default branch is `main` (syncWorktreeIfOnMain only acts when branch==='main'). NO template/embed concern: alloc.ts is pure runtime src, not vendored/templated (no embed-vendor:check needed). SCOPE: exactly ONE story (operator declined runbook/observability extras); do not touch the 6 choke-point writers, do not add a recovery-runbook note.
